prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG modular head sprite atlas for a cozy Japanese manga-publisher management game. Generate EXACTLY SIX separate HEADS WITH BLANK FACES, arranged perfectly within a 3-column by 2-row regular grid, landscape 1536x1024 canvas. Each head fully contained within its 512x512 cell with generous transparent margin at least 35px. True transparent background, absolutely no backdrop, labels, checkerboard, shadows, text, bodies or shoulders. Cute high quality chibi pixel-art illustration, clean dark chocolate pixel outlines, warm peach skin, restrained shaded blocks. Same scale and right-facing three-quarter view in ALL SIX: left ear visible on image-left, nose plane projects toward IMAGE-RIGHT. A small short neck joins at lower middle; comparable head silhouette size and neck anchor in every cell. Hair MUST be muted blue-violet (#605a90 base) in every head, including senior temples, so runtime recoloring works. Flat BLANK face regions with NO eyes, NO brows, NO nose, NO mouth, NO glasses, NO moustache; these will be separate overlays. Faces are not babies or teens: adult lower-face shapes with slightly broader jaws, dignified soft cheeks for elders. Heads in reading order: 1 adult man short tidy buzz-cut with masculine square-ish jaw; 2 adult man neat side-part slick hair and moderately angular jaw; 3 middle-aged man receding hairline with short hair at sides, broader soft jaw; 4 middle-aged woman short rounded wavy perm, fuller cheeks; 5 elderly man mostly bald crown with sparse side and back hair, broader ears and soft aged facial contour; 6 elderly woman swept-back hair into a small bun, soft cheeks and visible forehead. The blank face area of each should occupy a large right-centered region for later interchangeable features. Preserve identical art style and lighting throughout. Isolated professional game components, sharp edges, no blur, do not crop any hair or neck.
